questions.question: Two people 16 km apart walk simultaneously. Walking towards each other they meet in 2 h; same direction they meet in 8 h. Find their speeds.
solutionSteps: Towards each other: Relative speed $= u+v$. $2(u+v) = 16 \Rightarrow u+v = 8$.
Same direction: Relative speed $= u-v$. $8(u-v) = 16 \Rightarrow u-v = 2$.
